description: Build a bounded, line-complete derived index of the caller's isolated V3 source snapshot, with symbol ownership, static references, explicit parser uncertainty and live freshness.
skill_summary: Scan the current session workspace, check coverage and freshness, and navigate exact indexed lines, symbols and static references. Read-only queries never rescan.
migration_note: Compiled V3 adapter, scoped policy and configuration passed focused tests and authenticated V3 API acceptance. Execution still requires applicable installation, account-tier, agent, membership and session grants.
